name: GOOSE trip publisher interface
summary: Identifies the event-message output carrying the assigned protection trip information.
description: Identifies the event-message output carrying the assigned protection trip information. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Protection trip state” at the input and “Published trip event” at the output. Message reception is not proof of breaker opening.
